articles.summary: 150053568350107_1555136136636668 feeds_service November 3, 2026 Our 2026 Community Tour took us to Pinehouse last week, where we connected with community members, shared Collaboration Agreement updates and welcomed more than 80 students to an afternoon workshop covering reclamation, exploration, career opportunities and more. We also had the chance to cheer on the Pinehouse Lakers football team during their playoff win, enjoy a delicious community meal and reconnect with friends old and new. We’re kicking things off at the trade show and opening reception today, with plenty more to come over the next three days. If you're attending this year's event, stop by the Cameco booth, say hello to our team and chat with us about our operations, careers and opportunities at Cameco.
